skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract Numbers
skills.definition: Perform subtraction of whole numbers or fractions with the same denominator, including after borrowing.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: Borrow one from the whole part when the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, adding the denominator to the fraction and then subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert Improper Fraction
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction to a mixed number, or simplify a mixed number that contains an improper fraction.

skills.name: Rewrite Whole Number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5).

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator and simplify the result to lowest terms if needed.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator, convert both fractions to equivalent fractions, subtract the numerators, and simplify the result.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers
skills.definition: For two numbers (whole, fraction, or mixed), express them as mixed numbers, subtract the whole parts, subtract the fraction parts (using the appropriate fraction subtraction skill), borrow from the whole part if the fraction result is negative, and combine the final whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator, convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator, then subtract the numerators.

skills.name: Manage mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers (including rewriting whole numbers as mixed), subtract the whole numbers, and combine the results into a mixed number or whole number.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the subtrahend is larger than the fraction part of the minuend, borrow 1 from the whole part by adding the denominator to the fraction numerator and recalculating the subtraction; repeat if necessary.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Perform integer subtraction of the whole number parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, decrease the whole number part by 1, add the denominator to the fraction part, and repeat subtraction; may be applied multiple times.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Manipulate mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into whole and fraction parts, combine whole and fraction parts to form a mixed number, and rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator.

skills.name: Handle whole numbers
skills.definition: Recognize whole numbers and mixed numbers, convert them to a form with a whole part and a fractional part (e.g., 3 = 3 0/d), and subtract the whole parts.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator and write the result over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: Decrease the whole part by 1 and add the denominator to the numerator of the fraction part when the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, then perform the fraction subtraction again.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
